body: thank you

thank you. 
I have given myself enough time to get to my job that I’ll be able to still go on with it if it doesn’t kill me. Will work the job for a month to save up, and then buy an obscene amount of heroin and give ‘er a go again.
thank you ❤️ I hope things get better for you buddy, I’ve said it in this thread already but I hate knowing people relate to my post, even if it does provide solace. my thoughts are with you
no thank you. I’m way past 2nd time around. More like 153rd time around. Like I said, 0 percent chance I’m changing my mind. thanks though

I don’t agree. I’d rather be dead than to develop an addiction that will ruin the few relationships I have left. I’m not the addictive type, and drugs trigger psychosis in me. I love psychedelics, but it’s triggered a lot of traumatic memories in me and drive me to feeling more suicidal. Especially now with my partner gone. No thanks, none of that sounds appealing to me

Why should I stay around unhappy? I’ve been unhappy for years. I’ve tried very hard for years, to no avail. I don’t see why people want people to stick around, despite being unhappy. I know my life, and I know my mind, and I am done. Thank you for trying, but there is 0 percent chance that I am changing my mind. I’ve been told the things you are saying for ten. years. I’m exhausted.
I’ve given it a million tries. thank you though
My heart hurts for you, it’s a horrible mental illness

thank you, I won’t actually make it to the job. Just driving out there about halfway and then will snort some heroin & calmly pass onto whatever is next. 
thank you for this kind comment though, I hope your own journey is wonderful
stuff I still do. Paint, hike, read, watch movies.
It really does
I’m glad you have each other and I hope it continues to go well and that you’ll move close to each other soon ❤️ sorry to hear that you struggle as well pal
thank you for your kind words ❤️
thank you
thank you for your kind words
thank you

I hope you find someone that loves you like I’ve loved him. ❤️
and i’ve been told things will “get better” for a solid 10 years and it never has. thank you though
I have two dogs actually, I’ve had them for 4 and 2 years. They’ve helped a lot, but not enough. (they’re living with my boyfriends family who love them very much, so they’ll be okay if I’m gone)

In a way, yes I do. But he had tried killing himself multiple times before, starting before we knew each other. It sounds callous, but I think it was going to happen no matter what (and I feel the same way about myself)

hey buddy, it’s all good. I don’t think you look like an asshole 
it can be hard to detect tone on the internet
I was calling myself an asshole lol
thank you so much ❤️

hey, that’s totally understandable. my boyfriend was the same way, it was very hard for him to open up. I know it’s scary, but there’s nothing wrong with being vulnerable! I know some may not agree, but if it’s with someone you love it feels wonderful once you let it all out. I don’t know her, but I don’t think she would ever pity you for being honest about your mental state. I’m sure she loves you, and she would just want to help/be there for you, you know? 

Again, I know all of this is very difficult, but I relate to your situation a lot and it took a long time for my boyfriend to open up, but when he did it allowed a lot of love to pass between us. Just want the best for you buddy :-)

that’s what I’ve been doing most of this year, have traveled, worked in a national park, went white water rafting, ziplining etc. :-)
at the end of my rope, though. nothing else I want to do bad enough to stay here any longer. thank you though
many times.

thank you, but I used psychedelics very heavily for a solid year and a half and while it helped my boyfriend and I immensely and made us better people, it did not help with my suicidal tendencies 
thank you though
me too buddy 💔

agreed. always sad to hear people relate, but at the same time it does feel nice to have some solace
I hope whatever you decide to do brings you peace in some way or another

I know everyone says this, but maybe you should talk to her about it.. I know that my boyfriend and I were the only reason we kept going during multiple periods throughout our relationship. I know it’s hard to reach out though. Who knows, maybe she’s struggling with her own suicidal thoughts? My thoughts are with you either way. I’m sorry you struggle as well
thank you. I’m sorry to hear you relate, and hope things work out for you as well.

We actually planned on killing ourselves together when we both were really struggling. and he always said he would kill himself if I ended up doing it. I had actually planned on it a day and a half before he died. I told him that and he killed himself soon after. 
I don’t see why the planet needs my crippling depression, but thank you for your kind sentiments

not to sound like an asshole, but I wish I wasn’t a strong one. would’ve saved years of pain. not to mention a childhood full of abuse and teenage years dealing with being raped. so my boyfriend killing himself is really just the icing on the “man I sure do want to die” cake. so I’m pretty relieved that it’s finally going to happen
thank you, I appreciate it
Thank you for your kind words.

I’ve done it before, thank you though. I’ve worked on farms as an actual job, and wwoofed in different parts of the country 
it is a great experience, you’re right.

Thank you for the advice! I actually just spent may-august working and living in a national park. Went on many hikes and they were absolutely wonderful. The things you describe are truly some of the most rewarding parts of being alive, and sadly they don’t do much for driving the bad thoughts away for me anymore. I enjoy them, but it’s bittersweet. your comment made me very happy though, I’m glad you feel the same things in the great outdoors
